title: fix(metadata-protocol): a customization pair's row of a name two namespaces hold is judged against its own base, whichever package registered first (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DTWMrxHhXGd1ihAZkAUVAex)_

Fixes #32552

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个不同命名空间的包都出货同名条目（例如 flow `f`），各自带一个声明过的 `.custom` 覆盖时，删除覆盖、回滚提交、启动普查这三处原来只拿“先注册的那个包”当基准判断；现在对每个出货包分别判断，后注册那个包的覆盖也能正常删除、回滚。启动普查与读取保持一致：flow 和 action 不再把第二个包正在生效的覆盖报成“无人服务、请删除”；页面、应用、数据集、文档、手册、映射这六类读取仍只认先注册的包（#33131 再改），普查也照旧。
- 为什么改：结果原本取决于包的注册顺序（ADR-0150 D4 要求每个持有包的声明覆盖各自成立）；后注册的包删自己的覆盖会被 `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` 拒掉，回滚失败，普查还会建议删掉一个正在生效的定制。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽（widening），不收紧任何已有答案；单一持有包的行为逐条不变（CONTROL 钉住）。不是任何持有包的配对行仍然 403。回滚 = revert 本 PR，只动 `metadata-protocol` 三个源文件。本轮（复审 s1）把普查收窄到与 #32613 的读取一致。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-environment-rows.ts` 新增的 `someShipperOf`（判定核心）；`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` 的删除判定与启动普查两处 hunk；`protocol-class-head.ts` 的 `restoreWriteFor`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts`，预期 45/45 通过；其中 `[#32552]` 组两种注册顺序、各禁用一个持有包、映射类 CONTROL 以及单持有包 CONTROL 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

For a name two packages of two namespaces ship, each with its paired `.custom` holding a declared override (ADR-0146 D2), three answers judged the pair's row against the one package the bare-name artifact lookup (`packagedArtifactOwner`) answers, so they depended on which package registered first. Each now asks `someShipperOf` (new, `protocol-environment-rows.ts`): the bare-name owner first and alone while it holds (a one-holder name answers exactly as before), then every package that ships the name (`shippingPackageIds` over `shippedArtifactsOf`). No shipper is picked: the row judged is always the one its own `package_id` names.

| Door | Second-registered holder B, before | Now | One holder (CONTROL) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `DELETE /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=B.custom` (`deleteMetaItem`); pinned for a flow, and an action in the condition-1 probe | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`; B's override stays | `200`, B's override removed (runtime-only), A's untouched; every listed and execution-view entry of the name is its own package's | unchanged: `200`, removed |
| `revertCommit` of a commit into `B.custom` (restore limb; the per-item rollback shares `restoreWriteFor`); pinned for a flow | item in `failed[]`, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`; nothing restored | restored as the pair's declared override | unchanged: restored |
| boot census `metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved` (`loadMetaFromDb`), a flow or an action only | named B's live declared override as unserved, to delete | not named | unchanged: not named |

Every row is the `widening` arm (epic ruling 6819293900 condition 2). With one of the two holders disabled (ADR-0150 D3) the bare-name answer is still the first-registered holder, so the same three answers moved the same way whichever holder is disabled; a binding never moves with a reversible disable. Unchanged in both: a row of a package that is no shipper's pair keeps its removal `403` and is still named by the census.

The census judges a row as the reads serve it (`declinesStoredRow`). Since #32613 (#33126) the reads serve a second holder's declared override per shipper for a flow and an action only, so the census moves for those two types alone. A page, app, dataset, doc, book or mapping keeps the name's first-registered shipper in the census, as in the reads, until #33131 moves them: the second holder's override of such a name is still named (review 6859128505 s1).

Files: `protocol-environment-rows.ts` (+`someShipperOf`), `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` (removal judgement; census, per shipper for a flow and an action), `protocol-class-head.ts` (`restoreWriteFor`), the changeset, and the pins in `packages/objectql/src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts`.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts`, describe `[#32552]`, each in both registration orders:

- `?package=B.custom` removes B's override, never A's (and the mirror order).
- CONTROL: removing a row of a package that is neither holder's pair keeps its refusal.
- each holder's commit into its own pair reverts.
- the boot census names no holder's declared override as unserved, and still names a stranger's row.
- epic ruling 6819293900 condition 1 probe: after the second holder's override is removed, every listed flow and action is its own package's, beside a package-less row of the name.
- with each holder disabled in turn: each holder's pair removal and commit revert are admitted, and the census names neither.
- CONTROL (new this round): two holders' declared mapping overrides; the census still names the second-registered holder's, `mapping×1`, in both orders.
- CONTROL, one holder disabled, and CONTROL, one holder: removal, revert and census answer as before.

Ablation, two legs on head `d311b66322`, each rebuilt with `ablation-dist-preflight` proving the mutation reached `dist/`, restored by `git checkout HEAD` with HEAD blob hashes matched and a clean whole-tree `git status`:

- Leg A, the census type restriction removed (`perShipperType = true`, marker present in 2 built files): **2 failed / 43 passed of 45**, exactly the two mapping CONTROLs: `AssertionError: expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`.
- Leg B, the fix's three source files put back to `origin/main` (`someShipperOf` absent from all 24 built files): **12 failed / 33 passed of 45**, every two-holder pin red, every CONTROL green; quoted `Serialized Error: { code: 'NOT_OVERRIDABLE', status: 403 }`.
- Restore: rebuilt, `someShipperOf` present and the leg-A marker absent in `dist/`, 45/45.

## Acceptance notes

- This branch resumes `claude/project-thread-31hd5y@d4d32416` and merges `origin/main` at `c35a911b30`, and again at `ae11537eae` after #33126 landed (no conflict). The branch had carried PR #32815's round-3 head; the four conflicts (`objectql/src/registry.ts`, the two `package-scoped-*` test files, `18.pair-row-locale-addition-refused.ts`) each take main's landed copy (`e336a33eb`), and the two `32408-*` changesets stay deleted (consumed by version packages #29963). The diff against `main` is the card's five files only.
- The census row overlaps #32859 (blocked by this card): after this lands, the census no longer names a second holder's served declared flow or action override. The seat judges whether #32859's remainder still stands; this PR does not close it.
- Epic ruling 6819293900 condition 3: #32613 has landed (#33126) and is in this head; #32568 is closed.
- Round 2 answers contract review 6859128505: s1 (census in step with #33126's served set, table names the census row's types) and n1 (each row names what it is pinned on).
- #32561 shares `objectql/src/registry.ts` and the migration entry and waits for this card; this PR no longer touches either.
